answer: Reaching eligibility takes 35 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an attacker pays for every seat it wants. The jade register is checked at draw time, walnut lists the eligible set, and dawn seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 35 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh army of identities has no way to grade its own output. Each copy needs 2 hours of work. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
